origin.description: The delimiter is a tab and blank rows are skipped.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The delimiter is a tab and blank rows are skipped.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
token <- tokenizer_tsv()
paste(if (identical(token$delim, "\t")) "TAB" else token$delim, yn(token$skip_empty_rows), sep = ";")
